reviews.text: Great selection

Great store with great staff who genuinely love animals. Staff are always nice to you and they are all a great team. The staff are all helpful and friendly,

The team in there are so lovely and friendly, they want to talk about your pets and ended up showing photos of my new kitten. Nothing was a bother and even offered to help me take my big order out to the car. Will definitely be a regular.

Really unhappy with the service I received from Eddie I was looking to buy an adoption rabbets to bond with mine as one passed aeau and he gave me such an earful and a lecture on how I don’t know what I’m doing and that maybe I shouldn’t get this animal. It’s a shame because there’s are other staff in there who are just as bad. One staff member rolled her eyes at me when I asked for a bag after I payed as I began to count money to pay for it. From what I can tell heather seems to be the only kind member of staff in there but I’ve only been helped by her once or twice

We lost our beloved cat recently, and brought him here for their cremation services. I cant thank the staff enough for their kindness, they made an almost impossible situation bearable. If I could give them ten stars I would. Thank you everyone.

Absolutely fabulous service from Pets at home in Great Western Retail Park this morning 02/06/26. A friendly good morning from the very tall staff member behind the counter, then a friendly smile from another staff member as they moved stock out the way when I was heading that direction. They picked a heavy box off the shelf, even checked my phone for my pet club discount (I didn't have my reading glasses!) and then carried the box to my car, asked where I'd like it and put it in the back seat for me. Also the cost of my items were an absolute bargain! (It's a big deal for me getting out with various health issues, but this experience this morning made it so much better), I had the best experience, thank you for being kind and also excellent customer care in general. :)
Always have a good experience at pets at home, friendly helpful staff  always stocked well so you are sure to get what you are shopping for
Great selection of foods, health care and everything oet related.
Great selection for all pets and the staff are really knowledgeable and friendly too.

I took one of my unwell cats here a while ago who unfortuntely passed away 😢 However these guys madr sure my cat got as top tier treatement he could get without burning the bank and they offered clippings and paw print service when he did pass. I recieved these yesterday from the team at pets @ Home with a really nice card paying tribute to our cat and sympathy for the loss. Otherwords, When there top tier recommendations for food brands to buy for getting our cats to eat while on medications etc and alot of variety for many things youll need for pets. I still have another cat for which i just bought ger some catnip & some toys from here today. 100% recommend also the food here is cheaper than going to supermarket.
